identity: 法鼓文理學院・綜合大樓（GA／GB／GC）
scope: Complete connected GA 4 main floors, GC 2 floors and three quarter-sector lecture halls, GB 2-storey tall hall and lower connector; courtyard stairs, multilevel bridges and visible slope base. Excludes bridge, dormitories and Yangsheng Hall.
basis: Architect 2015 project listing and completion photographs with unknown capture date, plus official 2020 usage plan; not a 2026 condition or measured as-built.
coordinate_hand: Plan image u-right -> world +Y; v-down -> world +X; image-to-world handedness corrected before mesh generation. Front -Y faces GC left and GB right.
supports: Bridge undersides, gallery overhangs, lecture podiums, GA top frames and stair slabs require supports. Miniature glazing is opaque; interiors mostly solid. No physical print or universal minimum-wall claim.
